premises.text: Average men hate clothes shopping, distrust online fit, and still buy mostly offline
premises.evidence_span: I know how much men hate shopping for clothes

premises.text: Branded is a marketplace pairing shopping-averse men with people who love to shop, enabled by MAIL style/size profiles
premises.evidence_span: Branded is a marketplace that connects men who hate shopping with people that love to shop

premises.text: Human shoppers discover inventory across the web and boutiques and refine picks via in-app feedback
premises.evidence_span: his shopper can use this data to give him better recommendations in real time

premises.text: Return-like-a-man pickup returns charge only kept items plus a shopper tip after collection
premises.evidence_span: As soon as his return's collected, he gets charged for the items that he kept, plus a tip that goes to his shopper

premises.text: Shoppers need style sense and time, not formal fashion credentials, drawing from underemployed creative workers
premises.evidence_span: you don't have to be a fashion expert to be a shopper at Branded

value.text: Average men can shop for clothes online with human help and frictionless returns
value.evidence_span: We built Branded for the average Joe
